task: Stable reader bottom panel design previews
status: Design only; awaiting user choice; no app source changes

options.name: Steady dock
options.behavior: Full-width dock with permanently reserved single-line status. Status changes in place.
options.tradeoff: Most familiar; uses space for a status line.

options.name: Floating card
options.behavior: Anchored inset card with two rows. Permanent thin loading rail and a fixed-width status beside Text/PDF.
options.tradeoff: More compact; header status has less horizontal space.

options.name: Quiet toolbar
options.behavior: Utility row above three transport controls. Fixed-footprint loading ring around play; detailed status in expanded settings.
options.tradeoff: Least status text; loading state less explicit.

implementationConstraints: Choose dock dimensions from screen size and accessibility font scale, independently of audio state.
Preserve the reading viewport and control positions across ready, preparing, playing, buffering, and error states.
Remove dynamic prepare-ahead banners from the collapsed reader layout; retain details and cancellation in expanded settings.
Render loading feedback inside reserved space; never animate dock height or translate the reader during audio preparation.
Keep status single-line with overflow handling where present.
Initial preparing state may disable play; background preparation must not disable Pause or other currently valid controls.
Preserve sentence and word highlighting and existing red sentence failure behavior.
Keep the existing controls approximately 58dp for primary and at least 48dp touch targets.

codeEvidence.finding: Conditional status row adds at least 48dp below playback controls.
Weighted reader page shares parent column with dock, so dock-height changes alter viewport.
Prepare-ahead card above dock also has conditional content.
Existing transport cells and primary control already reserve size.

validationAfterApproval: Measure viewport and dock bounds through repeated preparation and buffering transitions in Text and PDF modes.
Check primary control behavior during initial loading versus background preparation while playing.
Check narrow screens, enlarged text, navigation insets, expanded settings and preserved controls.
limitations: Static generated previews illustrate layout intention. Actual flicker has not been reproduced or fixed in this design task.
